summary: This Makefile snippet checks the PHP version by using a regex pattern to detect if it's version 7, then stores the result in a variable. When the doThing target runs, it prints different messages depending on whether PHP 7 was detected or not.

explanations.1: The shell command runs a regex test on PHP_VERSION; if it matches the pattern '7' followed by digits and a decimal point at the end, echo 'yes', otherwise echo nothing. The result gets stored in IS_PHP_7.
explanations.4: ifdef checks whether the variable IS_PHP_7 was defined and has a non-empty value—if yes, execute the next block; if no, jump to the else block.
